title: The Real Roadrunner Sprints 20 mph and Hunts Rattlesnakes

scenes.text: The greater roadrunner can sprint about twenty miles an hour.
It would rather run than fly.
Its menu includes scorpions, lizards and rattlesnakes.
It is one of the few animals that hunts rattlesnakes.
And it slams prey against the ground. The cartoon was not that far off.

description:
The greater roadrunner can sprint about 20 miles an hour, and it is one of the few animals that hunts rattlesnakes.
It often batters its prey against the ground.
Did you grow up watching the cartoon? Comment below.
first_comment: A real bird that hunts rattlesnakes. Which cartoon animal is closest to its real-life version?
